intro: Open Range Bot arrives with the familiar pitch: AI analysis, automatic entries, a US$200 start and a practice account. The pitch is polished. The fine print is where the questions begin, and that is what this review measures.
It is a web platform with two modes: automatic, where the models execute according to your settings, and manual, where you confirm each entry yourself. Entry costs US$200 and includes a demo.
We reviewed the public record: pricing, restrictions, support hours, payout wording and every claim in between. Where the record contradicts itself, the scorecard marks it down.
whatItClaims: Free registration, with account activation by confirmation link.
Risk settings adjustable before the first live trade.
A partner broker holding funds and executing orders.
Withdrawals processed in under a day, per the page.
No prior trading experience required.
whatWeChecked: The ownership trail: who operates the platform and where.
The support channels: live chat, email or phone availability.
The fine print: clauses that qualify the headline promises.
The fee framing: no platform fees, but spreads embedded in every trade.
The support story: around-the-clock coverage claimed, exact figures conflicting.
The geo-restrictions: two lists on the page that do not agree.

faqs.q: What is the minimum deposit?
faqs.a: US$200, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.

faqs.q: Can I trade manually?
faqs.a: Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$200, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

bottomLine: As a product, Open Range Bot offers the expected setup and nothing that breaks. The issues sit in the published claims, and the claims are avoidable if you trade the minimum.
